Messages.Author: MadCat
Messages.Body:
Just a little question that went out yesterday in my playgroup:

When, exactly, the tap effect of superior Propaganda is applied?
An example:
Vamp A uses Propaganda against me and I try to block with vamp B. Vamp A
increases his stealth so B cannot block him anymore. But vamp B plays a
Deflection on Metuselah Z. Does Z have to tap a ready minion? . When, in
this steps, takes place the tap effect?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From "MadCat" <donc...@tin.it> =====

>When, exactly, the tap effect of superior Propaganda is applied?

Like all actions, the effects or Propaganda are applied when the action
resolves successfully. [6.2.3]

>An example:
>Vamp A uses Propaganda against me and I try to block with vamp B. Vamp A
>increases his stealth so B cannot block him anymore. But vamp B plays a
>Deflection on Metuselah Z. Does Z have to tap a ready minion? . When, in
>this steps, takes place the tap effect?

If Z doesn't block (and doesn't bounce, etc.), then Z taps a ready
untapped minion when the action resolves.
